title: Detach a captured value from its cell
description: You can follow an upvalue before and after it stops sharing the enclosing cell.

steps.description: Upvalue stores a one-element list and an open flag. Both the getter and setter use cell[0].
close copies the current value into a fresh list and marks the upvalue closed. This implementation keeps using cell rather than a separate closed_value field.
The upvalue initially shares shared_cell. Updating that list changes the displayed open value from 0 to 7.

steps.question: Will writing 99 into shared_cell after close change uv's value?
steps.answer: No. close replaced uv.cell with its own list containing 7.

steps.description: The supplied output shows Upvalue(7, closed), then a read of 7. The detached cell preserves the captured value.
